content_sections.body: In this lesson, focus on an opinion frame followed by because and a relevant example. Notice how the ideas about flexible working hours are linked so that the listener can follow the speaker's meaning.
content_sections.title: Notice the language

content_sections.body: In my view, flexible working hours are helpful because people can avoid the busiest travel times. For example, my sister starts early and gets home before rush hour.
content_sections.title: Context and meaning

content_sections.body: Prepare a three-sentence response about flexible working hours. Include the lesson language, one concrete detail, and a clear link between your ideas.
